identity.title: Propagate execution scope through evidence ingest and projection

human_pressure.one_screen_brief: Carry producer-supplied scope_ref through the canonical evidence-package path without changing raw EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE storage, idempotency, conflict behavior, or direct native-event semantics.
human_pressure.why_now: 8053 adds the canonical field; the evidence ingress boundary must preserve it end-to-end before governance records can use it.
do_not_misread: Do not unwrap or rewrite raw stored evidence beyond the existing projection-only normalization boundary.
Do not infer scope_ref from text, pack names, step IDs, or event ordering.
red_lines: Raw evidence provenance wrapper remains unchanged.

machine_core.goal: Preserve an explicit producer-provided scope_ref from evidence-package events through ingest and projection while maintaining existing producer-neutral storage semantics.
red_lines: Do not alter event idempotency/conflict checks.
Do not derive scope_ref from intent or runtime-specific payload fields.
Do not change governed outcome or signal rules.
Do not introduce a new BLOCKED or HUMAN_REVIEW path.
invariants: Only explicit contract-supported scope_ref becomes canonical scope identity.
EXTERNAL_EVIDENCE remains the stored wrapper for imported package events.
Direct native events continue to project unchanged.
Missing or malformed scope remains unscoped/unknown rather than inferred.

producer.artifact: runtime evidence package event with optional scope_ref

observable_effect.assertion: Explicit scope_ref survives the producer-neutral evidence path and is visible in canonical projection structures without mutating raw stored evidence.

proofs.assertion: Evidence-package ingest and projection tests prove scoped, unscoped, malformed, and direct-native cases.

failure_semantics: Malformed scope_ref remains unavailable to projection.
Unknown imported events remain source-preserved unknown.

steps.title: Trace scope at ingress
details: Identify the contract-supported location of scope_ref in imported evidence and preserve it without changing raw source payload semantics.

steps.title: Project scope generically
details: Extend projection-only normalization so canonical scoped events retain explicit scope identity.

steps.title: Prove compatibility
details: Cover scoped, missing, malformed, imported-wrapper, and native-event paths.

acceptance: Raw wrapper and source payload remain preserved.
No scope is inferred from producer-specific fields.

reject_if: scope_ref is inferred from pack/iteration/step text.

validation_notes.targeted_contract_coverage: Evidence-package and projection tests exercise the exact ingress-to-projection boundary.
